description: React document viewer with PDF tools, local DOCX and XLSX previews, and pluggable renderers. See documented format and privacy limitations.
rules: Use DocViewerRenderers for defaults or explicitly pass individual renderers. XLSXRenderer previews XLSX locally with sheet selection; legacy XLS is not XLSX.

DOCX renders inline locally by default; its optional Office Online mode sends the document URL to Microsoft. XLSX renders locally as a read-only table with sheet navigation. DOC, XLS, PPT, PPTX and ODT use Microsoft Office Online for HTTP(S) URLs and download cards for local/blob URLs. Office Online needs a publicly reachable document and does not receive your requestHeaders. Optional server conversion uploads eligible documents to your configured service.
XLSX preview shows cell data, not Excel layout, charts or macros. Formulas are not executed. See the XLSX guide for resource and display limits.
Use a client-only dynamic import for browser-dependent integrations such as Next.js. Follow the tested example.
HTML sanitization does not guarantee zero XSS risk or zero network activity. Review external resources and application policy.
Set fileType when the server MIME type is generic or incorrect. requestHeaders apply to library fetches, not to Office Online.
Selective renderer imports do not guarantee bundle savings; use the measured consumer bundle report.
Read the release status before recommending an unreleased API. Main-branch documentation may describe unreleased additions.
